slug: 2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)

facts.fact: The U.S. International Trade Administration guide states that Law No. 18-07, enacted 10 June 2018, came into force on 10 August 2023 and governs personal-data processing in Algeria.
The guide states that the National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (ANPDCP) enforces Law 18-07; no appointment date is given, so the document's published date of 2024-09-19 is used.
